meaning: the entity places a piece, a `template` entity kept inside the site template, once or on a grid of instances at its own pose; the template evaluation engine lays the instances out as authored entities when it makes a site, and no generator expands it

schema.title: template.placement
schema.description: the entity places a piece, a `template` entity kept inside the site template, once or on a grid of instances at its own pose; the template evaluation engine lays the instances out as authored entities when it makes a site, and no generator expands it
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from Agent Studio's 05-template-workflow.md section 3.2 (notes/agent-studio-2026-10-17/design/specs/05-template-workflow.md). Open to fields a newer writer adds (SPEC section 9).

piece.description: The piece placed: an entity carrying `template` in the site template's own scopes, named without a pin.

params.description: Values bound to the piece's parameters by name, each replacing a `$param` of that name whole, as a stamp's do. A reference passed here is carried as data and never indexed.

stands_for.description: Where a list elsewhere names this placement, the made entities of these local handles take its place, instance by instance; absent, every top-level product does.

repeat.title: repeat
repeat.description: Instance (i, j), for i below count[0] and j below count[1], stands at the pose's position plus [i * pitch[0], j * pitch[1]], at the pose's heading. Without a repeat the placement makes one instance, (0, 0).

count.description: Instances along x and along y; a zero in either makes none.

pitch.description: The distance between neighbouring instances along the pose frame's x and y axes, in its steps; the heading does not turn it.

local_handle.title: local handle
local_handle.description: A piece internal's handle, as proto/schema/values.json writes one.

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Another entity, by identity: a declared UUID or a derivation address, bare or with a pin. Which pin a field takes is the pin rule's to enforce: within the referrer's unit bare or `@head`, across units a changeset (a tag once tags land).

entity_id.title: entity id
entity_id.description: A declared entity's UUID or a derived entity's address, either arm (SPEC section 3).
